nodes.summary: The genotype (reference-allele count) `x_i ∈ {0, 1, 2}` of individual `i`.
nodes.title: Genotype of an individual at a biallelic locus

nodes.summary: The diagonal estimator of GCTA (Yang et al. 2011) at one locus, `A_ii = 1 + (x_i² - (1 + 2p) x_i + 2p²) / (2p(1 - p))`.
nodes.title: GCTA diagonal relationship estimator

nodes.summary: The genetic relationship matrix entry of Yang et al. (2010) at one locus, `A_ij = (x_i - 2p)(x_j - 2p) / (2p(1 - p))`.
nodes.title: Genetic relationship matrix entry

nodes.summary: Identity by descent is symmetric.
nodes.title: Symmetry of identity by descent

nodes.summary: A gene copy is identical by descent with itself: `ibd c c = 1`.
nodes.title: A gene copy is identical by descent with itself

nodes.summary: Malécot's identity-by-descent model at one biallelic locus, at the level of second moments. The individuals are `ι`; individual `i` carries the gene copies `(i, 0)` (paternal) and `(i, 1)` (maternal), and `allele c ∈ {0, 1}` indicates the reference allele on copy `c`. The reference allele has frequency `p ∈ (0, 1)` (a polymorphic locus), and `ibd c d` is the probability that the copies `c` and `d` are identical by…
nodes.title: Malécot's identity-by-descent model

nodes.summary: The inbreeding coefficient `F_i`: the probability that the two copies of `i` are identical by descent.
nodes.title: Inbreeding coefficient

nodes.summary: Products of allele indicators are integrable.
nodes.title: Integrability of products of allele indicators

nodes.summary: The allele indicators are integrable.
nodes.title: Integrability of allele indicators

nodes.summary: Products of genotypes are integrable.
nodes.title: Integrability of products of genotypes

nodes.summary: Genotypes are integrable.
nodes.title: Integrability of genotypes

nodes.summary: The genetic relationship covariance (Yang et al. 2010): `𝔼[(x_i - 2p)(x_j - 2p)] = 2p(1 - p) · 2 φ_ij`.
nodes.title: The genetic relationship covariance

nodes.summary: `𝔼[x_i x_j] = 4p² + 4p(1 - p) φ_ij`.
nodes.title: Second moment of genotypes in terms of kinship

nodes.summary: The GCTA diagonal estimator is unbiased for `1 + F_i` (Yang et al. 2011): `𝔼[1 + (x_i² - (1 + 2p) x_i + 2p²) / (2p(1 - p))] = 1 + F_i`.
nodes.title: The GCTA diagonal estimator is unbiased for `1 + F_i`

nodes.summary: The diagonal GRM entry is unbiased for `1 + F_i`: `𝔼[A_ii] = 1 + F_i`.
nodes.title: Diagonal GRM entry is unbiased for $1 + F_i$

nodes.summary: The GRM is unbiased for twice the kinship (Yang et al. 2010): `𝔼[A_ij] = 2 φ_ij`, for every pair `i, j` (including `i = j`, where `2 φ_ii = 1 + F_i`).
nodes.title: The GRM is unbiased for twice the kinship

nodes.summary: The KING moment (Manichaikul et al. 2010) for two non-inbred individuals: `𝔼[(x_i - x_j)²] = 4p(1 - p)(1 - 2φ_ij)`.
nodes.title: The KING moment

nodes.summary: The KING moment (Manichaikul et al. 2010), general form: `𝔼[(x_i - x_j)²] = 2p(1 - p)(1 + F_i) + 2p(1 - p)(1 + F_j) - 8p(1 - p) φ_ij`.
nodes.title: The KING moment

nodes.summary: Kinship is symmetric.
nodes.title: Symmetry of kinship

nodes.summary: The kinship coefficient `φ_ij`: the probability that a copy drawn at random from `i` and a copy drawn at random from `j` are identical by descent.
nodes.title: Kinship coefficient

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
